plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog p. 311 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA-T in Political Science. REQUIREMENT 'Major, List A/B' mapped to major; 'Major + US/CA Politics' mapped to major (primary designation); 'US History' mapped to core. Footnote 1: HIST 7A, HIST 7B, and SOC 1 must be taken at College of Alameda to count for the specific CSU GE area. ENGL 5's catalog prerequisite is 'ENGL 001A or ENGL 001AS'; coded as ENGL 1A because the validator only matches top-level course codes and ENGL 1AS appears solely inside the Fall Y1 ENGL choice's options — the in-plan Fall Y1 ENGL 1A/1AS choice satisfies either prerequisite. MATH 13's catalog prerequisite (developmental math or placement) is assumed satisfied at entry and is not coded. No hard prerequisites are listed for the POSCI courses in the sequence; prereq lists are empty per standard. Unit ranges use the lower bound (ENGL 1A/1AS '4 or 5' → 4; MATH 13 '4 or 6' → 4); Fall Y1 prints '14-17'. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
